scope: Post-v14 old-case exploratory counterprobe; no fresh-test or accuracy claim. No changes to frozen v14 heads.

probes.parallel: two separate vessel mouths are visible side by side, corresponding to two adjacent containers rather than a single vertical bottle
probes.accessory: the main work is a human or animal figurine or sculpture holding or incorporating a small vessel as an accessory, rather than a stand-alone bottle or vase
